subject: Private deployment packaging: airgap/operational credits & support tier options
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@graystonehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Park <tom.park@graystonehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@graystonehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment packaging question (air-gapped site)

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the demo last week. Graystone is evaluating an air-gapped private deployment and procurement asked me to get clarity on a couple of pricing/packaging options before we escalate to legal:

- Can Redwood provide an amortized platform fee vs a single upfront platform invoice? Our finance team prefers OPEX treatment, ideally 12–18 months.
- Is there an operator-license credit model instead of a fixed platform fee (we often run on-prem operator budgets)?
- What do the support tiers look like for air-gapped installs? Are SRE oncall retainer options available?

I've attached a draft SOW to give context to expected architecture and run rates (SOW_draft_v1.pdf).

Would you be able to share a short options table (numbers are fine at a high level) and a recommended path for pilot -> production? Also: procurement will want SOC 2 evidence and an itemized invoice schedule.

Best,
Sara Liu
Head of Engineering Programs
Graystone Health

---
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@graystonehealth.com>
Cc: Tom Park <tom.park@graystonehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment packaging question (air-gapped site)

Hi Sara —

Appreciate the clear list. We can do both approaches; attached is a short worksheet with two illustrative constructs (privdeploy-pricing-options.xlsx) that I think maps to what procurement is asking for. High-level preview here:

Option A — Amortized platform fee:
- Platform fee: $120,000 (can be amortized over 12 or 18 months; default quote is 12 months)
- Operator licenses: 3 operator seats included
- Support: SRE Plus (8x5, 2hr response for Sev1) optional add-on

Option B — Operator-credit + retainer:
- Operator migration credit: $40,000 applied at signing (reduces upfront capex)
- Monthly retainer: $3,500/mo for on-call SLA and escalation support
- Platform runtime metering charged monthly for token/throughput usage

Pilot suggestion: 6-week pilot with 20% pilot discount on platform fee or a pilot credit that applies toward operator credit on conversion.

SOC 2 and compliance artifacts are available; I'll pull relevant docs for procurement. Would you be available for a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk the procurement team through these mechanics?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: privdeploy-pricing-options.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: sketch for Graystone pricing options (confidential)

Team —

Following Jasmine's note, here's an internal sketch for numbers we can present. This note is internal only; do not forward externally without legal review.

Scenario 1 (12mo amortize)
- Platform fee: $120,000 amortized monthly = $10,000/mo (12 months)
- Operator seats: 3 included (each seat = ability to run ops console + operator support)
- Onsite/airgap packaging: one-time engineering packaging fee = $18,000
- Support: SRE Plus priced at $3,500/mo extra (includes 1 dedicated escalation channel)

Scenario 2 (operator-credit + retainer)
- Migration credit: $50,000 applied at signing (reduces upfront)
- Monthly retainer: $4,000/mo (covers 24x7 rotation and 1 major migration window)
- Platform runtime: metered at standard hosted rates for burst usage during pilot (we waive first 100k token equivalent)

Tradeoffs to call out to customer:
- Amortize (Scenario 1) gives predictable OPEX for finance but requires platform fee minimum to cover engineering packaging for airgap.
- Operator-credit (Scenario 2) lowers initial cash but increases monthly commitment via retainer; better for customers with capex budgets for operator licenses.

Recommended external position (two slides):
1) Present both constructs with an 18-month amortization alternative (reduces monthly run-rate)
2) Offer a pilot credit: 20–30% discount on the platform fee or a $30k migration credit if they sign within 30 days

Attachments to prepare: updated price worksheet, SOC 2 summary, packaging checklist.

Marissa
Director, Solutions Pricing
Redwood Inference

Jasmine / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick context. A few follow-ups from procurement and our CFO:
- Can you move the platform fee amortization to 18 months instead of 12 and show the revised monthly schedule?
- Procurement would like the total capitalized vs OPEX impact over 2 years (they asked if we can split invoices across two fiscal years).
- For the operator-credit path: can Redwood confirm the credit can be applied to professional services for packaging (we can't apply credits to license in our procurement system unless spelled out)?
- We need the SOC 2 Type II report and an itemized invoice template. Can you send the procurement questionnaire answers (attached).

Also — we have a pilot window in June; if we can secure a pilot discount or migration credit it will help us move internal approvals.

Attached: procurement-questionnaire.pdf (procurement-specific checklist).

Regards,
Sara

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks — quick answers and a proposed compromise that should help procurement/CFO:

1) Amortization: happy to present an 18-month amortization schedule. Revised numbers: $120,000 platform fee = $6,666.67/mo over 18 months (we'll provide a full invoice schedule).

2) Invoice split: we can split the invoice so the first 9 months are billed in FY25 and remaining 9 months in FY26 if needed — we'll reflect that in the term sheet.

3) Operator-credit application: yes, operator credit can be applied to professional services (packaging/migration) — we'll call this out explicitly in the SOW.

4) Pilot incentives: offer a $30,000 migration credit (applied to packaging PS) if Graystone signs within 30 days of this email, plus SRE Plus bundled for first 3 months at no charge.

5) Compliance artifacts: attaching SOC 2 summary and a procurement-ready invoice template; full Type II can be shared under NDA.

Next steps
